core_problem_solved: To provide the core runtime engine that discovers and executes tests written using the JUnit Jupiter (JUnit 5) programming model.
key_features: Discovers tests via class and method annotations (e.g., `@Test`, `@ParameterizedTest`)
Manages the full test lifecycle, including extensions and conditional execution
Reports execution results to build tools and IDEs
era_and_niche: A fundamental and required runtime component for the modern JUnit 5 testing framework, which is the most widely used testing framework in the Java ecosystem.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete**. It is the engine for the current major version of JUnit. It is the official successor to the test runner from the legacy **JUnit 4**. Its primary competitor in the Java testing space is **TestNG**.
